title: Carbon monoxide gas-phase infrared transmission
collection: Coblentz Society evaluated infrared reference spectra
state: GAS (400 mmHg DILUTED TO A TOTAL PRESSURE OF 600 mmHg WITH N2)
source_processing: DIGITIZED BY NIST FROM HARD COPY (FROM TWO SEGMENTS)
source_processing_note: CONGESTED ROTATIONAL LINES IN THE 2000-2250 CM^-1 REGION ARE SMOOTHENED
plot_processing: Decode the supplied numeric JCAMP X++(Y..Y) rows using row-anchor x values and DELTAX. Plot supplied transmittance values directly. No additional baseline correction, normalization, clipping, smoothing, fitting or artificial peaks.
limitations: This is a processed, hardcopy-digitized reference transmission record with upstream smoothing of the congested rotational region. It supports observing the band envelope, not fitting resolved rotational centres or deriving molar absorptivity.
rights: Retain the owner and collection copyright notice supplied in the unchanged original JCAMP-DX file; no additional licence is inferred.
